tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background (warm off-white; deep forest-black in dark). Every text token below is checked on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, the phone screen ground for raised content.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: section bands, segmented-control track, photo slots.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy, numbers. 14.9:1 on paper (light), 15.9:1 (dark). Also the focus ring color.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, meta (distance, time slot). ≥5.8:1 on paper, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card dividers only — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, unselected chip outlines. ≥3.3:1 on surface and paper (non-text contrast).

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand base: hero band, footer, dark CTA blocks, the 'done' pin. Pair with on-forest text.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on forest. 10.9:1 (light), 12.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: on-forest-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on forest (footer meta, captions in the hero band).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent — safety-vest orange. Primary buttons, available-mission pins, progress fills, the current step. Never as text on paper; text on it is on-signal.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on signal fills. 5.4:1 (light), 7.1:1 (dark). Never white on orange.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Orange when it must be text or a thin icon: links in body copy, 'Bonus' label, the current step number. 5.5:1 on paper (light), 8.7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind signal-text: Bonus tag, selected chip, highlighted payout step.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done / validated / paid — always with a check icon and a word. 5.7:1 on paper, 5.4:1 on success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of done states and the 'Paid' badge.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Waiting / in review — always with the clock icon and a word. 5.0:1 on pending-soft.

tokens.name: pending-soft
tokens.usage: Background of pending states.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only (cancel mission, invalid code), with an icon and a word. 5.4:1 on danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error messages and inline field errors.

tokens.name: level-bronze
tokens.usage: Bronze level chip text/icon, on level-bronze-soft (4.7:1 light).

tokens.name: level-bronze-soft
tokens.usage: Bronze chip background.

tokens.name: level-silver
tokens.usage: Silver level chip text/icon (5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: level-silver-soft
tokens.usage: Silver chip background.

tokens.name: level-gold
tokens.usage: Gold level chip text/icon (5.4:1 light).

tokens.name: level-gold-soft
tokens.usage: Gold chip background.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map ground between blocks (the streets read as gaps).

tokens.name: map-block
tokens.usage: City blocks on the map motif.

tokens.name: map-street
tokens.usage: Main avenues drawn over the grid.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Parks and green lots on the map.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: River or lake shapes on the map.

tokens.name: map-route
tokens.usage: Dashed route from 'you' to a mission pin.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: App screen titles, card group headings.

styles.sample: You choose when and where. No quotas.
styles.usage: Default copy everywhere; inputs use it too (16px stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: body-s

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small uppercase eyebrows above headings; badges.

styles.name: money-xl
styles.usage: Hero and pay-section amounts, payable balance. Always tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Amounts inside cards and lists, tabular.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks (meta lines), chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows and between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter, card padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero and large section breaks on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, photo slots, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, mission cards, map containers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, hero panels, phone screen corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, level chips, segmented toggles, the toast.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Soft depth, never a hard drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, bottom sheets, the floating hero mission card, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-pin
tokens.usage: Map pins, so they lift off the map.
